# Foreign Affairs

> > Foreign Affairs is the leading magazine of international relations and U.S. foreign policy, featuring analysis and debate on global security, diplomacy, economics, and regional conflicts.

Published by the Council on Foreign Relations, Foreign Affairs provides expert commentary on critical global issues including NATO expansion, Middle East strategy, China's rise, nuclear security, climate policy, and the evolving international order. The magazine features articles, letters to the editor, and responses from leading scholars and policymakers.

## Key Topics

- U.S. foreign policy
- NATO and European security
- China and Asia-Pacific
- Middle East conflicts (Iraq, Iran, Palestine)
- Multilateralism and international institutions
- Globalization and trade policy
- Nuclear proliferation and security
- Climate and environmental policy
- Transatlantic relations
- Humanitarian intervention
- Post-Cold War order
- Regional stability and state failure
- Cultural protectionism
- Counterterrorism and Al-Qaeda

## Global Security and Strategic Affairs

- [Leviathan Ascending?](https://www.foreignaffairs.com/articles/north-america/2003-06-03/leviathan-ascending): Doran's postscript on Palestine, Iraq strategy, and unipolar order theory
- [China's Dilemma](https://www.foreignaffairs.com/articles/china/2010-10-14/chinas-dilemma): Analysis of China's authoritarian control vs. growing social tensions
- [Hezbollah's Dilemma](https://www.foreignaffairs.com/articles/middle-east/2005-04-13/hezbollahs-dilemma): Byman's update on Hezbollah's transformation amid Syrian withdrawal
- [Pakistan's Stabilizing Arsenal](https://www.foreignaffairs.com/articles/asia/2010-07-01/pakistans-stabilizing-arsenal): Letter defending Pakistan's nuclear security and command-and-control
- [Logic, Not Lobbies](https://www.foreignaffairs.com/articles/russia-fsu/2009-06-17/logic-not-lobbies): Asmus and Rosner defend NATO enlargement against ethnic lobbying claims

## Transatlantic Relations and European Affairs

- [Dogma Days](https://www.foreignaffairs.com/articles/europe/2004-01-01/dogma-days): Letter on transatlantic alliance, NATO-EU relations post-Iraq War
- [Monument Wars](https://www.foreignaffairs.com/articles/estonia/2014-01-07/monument-wars): Estonia's Soviet monument removal and post-communist identity challenges
- [THE GOOD, THE BAD, AND THE UGLY](https://www.foreignaffairs.com/articles/australia/2000-09-01/good-bad-and-ugly): Letter on Austria's Freedom Party, EU sanctions, and right-wing extremism

## Globalization and Economic Policy

- [Yes, Globalization Passed Its Peak](https://www.foreignaffairs.com/world/yes-globalization-passed-its-peak): Abdelal and Segal argue financial crisis marks globalization's peak
- [EXCEPTION TO THE EXCEPTION](https://www.foreignaffairs.com/articles/france/2000-11-01/exception-exception): Letter debating French cultural protectionism and globalization policy
- [SHALL WE DANCE?](https://www.foreignaffairs.com/articles/japan/2000-09-01/shall-we-dance): Letter on Japan's government-business ties and economic recovery challenges
- [Letter From Delhi](https://www.foreignaffairs.com/articles/india/2011-08-15/letter-delhi): India's informal recycling sector as economic commodity, not waste toxin

## State Fragility and Governance

- [The World's Youngest Failed State](https://www.foreignaffairs.com/articles/comoros/2014-08-12/worlds-youngest-failed-state): Analysis of East Timor's post-independence struggles and state failure risk
- [Law & Order, Afghan Victims Unit](https://www.foreignaffairs.com/afghanistan/law-order-afghan-victims-unit): Afghan crime dramas educate public on civil procedure and rule of law
- [The Dark Side of Iran's Drug Policy](https://www.foreignaffairs.com/articles/afghanistan/2013-04-12/dark-side-irans-drug-policy): Schleifer's response on Iran's drug executions despite harm reduction

## International Institutions and Multilateralism

- [STOPPING SHORT](https://www.foreignaffairs.com/world/stopping-short): Letter debating UN peacekeeping, humanitarian intervention, multilateralism

## Optional

- [Fuzzy Math](https://www.foreignaffairs.com/articles/united-states/2002-01-01/fuzzy-math): Letter debating ANWR drilling economics and Alaska oil production policy
- [Cooling the Climate](https://www.foreignaffairs.com/articles/commons/2009-12-20/cooling-climate): Letter on short-lived climate forcers, black carbon, and Arctic policy
